question: The major festival of _____ 's tribes is kharchi Puja, Garia Puja, Ker Puja, Bizu Festival, Tirtha Mukh Festival. Ashokastami, Ganga Puja, Lampra Puja, Wah festival.
solution:
The correct answer is __Tripura__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Kharchi Puja: A traditional tribal festival worshiping the fourteen deities and involving rituals to cleanse earthly sins.
 
• Garia Puja: Celebrated by Tripuri tribes to worship the deity Garia for prosperity and a good harvest.
 
• Ker Puja: A protective festival invoking the guardian deity Ker to safeguard the people from calamities.
 
• Bizu Festival: Marking the New Year for the Chakma tribe, celebrated with dance, music, and traditional feasts.
 
• Tirtha Mukh Festival: A river festival where people gather at the confluence of rivers to pay homage to their ancestors.
 
• Ashokastami: Celebrated with Kirtan and religious rituals, it coincides with the festival of fair and splendor.
 
• Ganga Puja: Involves worshiping the goddess of the river Ganga to prevent natural calamities and for purification purposes.
 
• Lampra Puja: An indigenous festival where the Lampra deity is worshipped for protection against evil spirits.
 
• Wah Festival: A harvest festival where the tribes thank their deities for the bounty and pray for future prosperity.
